summary: PulseGuard v0.6.12 restores the missing optimizer detail surface and the post-update What's New window, while fixing two warnings found in the latest runtime log.

sections.heading: Live optimizer details restored
sections.detail: The large lower area on Optimize now shows persistent live FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL details, including Deep Clean areas, eligible items, removed items, space freed, skipped/error counts, recorded changes, and completed step results.

sections.heading: What's New works after updates again
sections.detail: Release notes now accept the current sections schema and legacy items schema, preventing StrictMode from hiding the changelog after an update.

sections.heading: Driver Engine startup fixed
sections.detail: A PowerShell string interpolation parse error in the OEM support-page warning path was corrected, allowing the current Driver Engine to load instead of falling back to the legacy path.

sections.heading: Scheduled startup scan warning fixed
sections.detail: Scheduled Task actions are now read defensively because not every Windows task action exposes Execute/Arguments. This prevents repeated StrictMode warnings during scans and verification.
